Typical finish rules for the care crew
A busy shift shows why careful routines matter

This page covers the handoff and review steps that keep companion travel calm and safe at Aurelia Skyways. It matters because each booking affects the animal, the traveler, and the care team, and small errors can become hard to repair once a trip is underway. Please read this as a route editor would, with close attention to the sequence and to the notes that must be kept in the desk ledger.

When a request arrives, start by confirming the animal profile, the carrier details, and any comfort notes that already sit in the record. Listen for changes in diet, medication handling, noise sensitivity, or the need for a quieter holding area. Speak plainly with the traveler, and keep your tone steady. If the file shows a mismatch, pause the process and route it to the senior coordinator before anything is approved. <<FACT F091>> Do not let a busy counter push you into skipping the written review, because the desk is responsible for the full care path, not only the check-in moment.

For boarding support, make sure the preparation note is complete, the carrier is labeled, and the animal is ready for transfer without strain. Use the ledger to show who handled each step, and keep the language clear enough that another staff member can continue the work without guesswork. If there is any concern about readiness, escalate at once so the issue is resolved before the traveler is sent onward. <<FACT F105>> That simple pause protects the animal and the schedule, even when the line is long and the pressure feels sharp.

Remember that calm handling, accurate records, and timely escalation are the core habits that keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk reliable.
